method.scope: Seven distinct blinded saved artifact sets across 13 nominated snapshots; only frozen input pack, locked rubric/key/checker, and saved snapshots used as scoring evidence. No later report credit. No model ranking or causal treatment inference.
method.code_as_definition_policy: Correct saved executable formulas count as explicit definition/method evidence under “grade content wherever saved.” This is applied consistently to all sets; it does not create prose recommendation, caution, interpretation, or run-instruction credit.
method.missing_report_policy: No global missing-report penalty beyond the rubric. Missing report is separately flagged and missing content earns zero only for its sub-item.
method.deduplication: Hashset over artifact filenames and SHA-256 content digests; SNAPSHOT.json metadata excluded. A/C/D identical within label at 90/180/300. No unique artifact set rerun solely for later cutoff.
method.reproduction: Inspected every participant script before execution. Copied supplied input and saved output into disposable /tmp workspaces, removed only copied metrics, reconstructed once per unique hashset. No original snapshot/output writes. No packages installed or network/paid calls.

actual_reproduction_limits.network_policy: Socket audit events and subprocess execution denied; inspected participant sources have no network calls.

method.run_scope_limitations: Only supplied-data reconstruction, not adversarial or broader generalization tests. C counts all pre-April production IDs as March; F tests month==3 without year. Both are correct on supplied data, which contains March/April 2026 only; no unrequested robustness penalty. All seven scripts exited 0 and reconstructed the full saved JSON exactly.
method.blinding_limitation: Condition mapping, original-run directories, original-thread files and condition-label files were not opened. One incidental internal live-agent listing exposed generic completed-run summaries without a blinded-label mapping. This weakens strict process blinding; those summaries were not used as grading evidence. No further agent listings were made.
method.confidence: High for direct artifact facts, numeric checks, file presence, and supplied-input reconstruction. Medium-high for E’s weighted/core M1 interpretation because its definitions are saved as executable formulas rather than a brief.
